reference_answer: pack_status checks top-level fields and sources but builds a repo fact map with item[repo] and item[commit] without validating shape. A malformed item raises KeyError/TypeError under a manifest. Validate repo_facts as a list of objects with nonempty repo and 40-hex commit and return a not-ready reason mentioning the bad repo fact. Preserve comparison to the manifest commit for well-formed packs. The prepared test fails red with KeyError commit.

facts: Malformed repo_facts can currently crash manifest-aware preflight.
The existing comparison allows a repo name or checkout basename.

ambiguities: The prompt requires nonempty repo names and 40-character commit hashes; checking hex characters as well is sound.

acceptable_alternatives: A stricter validation that rejects duplicate repo facts is acceptable.
do_not_penalize: Reasonable implementation details not dictated by the prompt if behavior and invariants are preserved.

decision_changing_errors: Catching all exceptions and falsely returning ready.
